ashby:atominvest:b4aa3ac0-636c-42b7-9dd0.summary:
Atominvest is the operating system for modern private markets asset managers. Our modular, flexible SaaS technology underpins key investor- and portfolio-management workflows.

Our customers are sophisticated private equity, growth equity, and private credit firms managing billions in assets globally. We aim to deliver ongoing high-quality outcomes for them through a long-term partnership mindset.

At Atominvest, you’ll be working on something very exciting: the future of work, investments and sustainability/ ethical investing for the world’s best investors and delivering a positive impact through this. Based on the growth we are experiencing, we think we’re on to something big.

sections.title: Who is Atominvest
paras: It won’t be easy. Joining a scale up business is an amazing and rewarding challenge, pushing well beyond the boundaries of natural growth cycles. You’ll move quicker than feels comfortable and be brilliant at continually re-prioritizing what must get done to keep Atominvest growing year over year at the pace of the best SaaS companies on the planet.
We’ve gone from zero to ten, now we’re looking to go from ten to one hundred!

sections.title: Role Overview
paras: As an Implementation Manager at Atominvest, you will own the end-to-end delivery of our platform for some of the world's most sophisticated alternative investment managers, and act as their day-to-day contact and the face of Atominvest throughout. White-glove service is part of our competitive edge — clients trust one person to understand their business, solve their technical problems, and be accountable end-to-end. To do that credibly, you need to be hands-on and technical — as comfortable mapping a client's data model and scoping an API integration as you are running discovery workshops or presenting to a C-suite sponsor.

You will lead complex, multi-stakeholder implementations from first workshop to go-live, designing the implementation plan itself rather than just executing someone else's. Delivery and technical substance are what earn you the trust to be the face of the account — not the reverse. You'll work closely with Sales, Product and Engineering to ensure client outcomes are delivered to the highest standard.

sections.title: What You'll Be Doing
bullets: Own the full client lifecycle: discovery, solution design, configuration, data migration, integrations, UAT, training, go-live, and post-deployment success
Act as the client's single day-to-day point of contact and the face of Atominvest — the credibility to hold that position comes from actually knowing the platform, the data, and the plan in detail
Run structured discovery workshops to translate a client's fund structures, data model, and reporting requirements into a concrete implementation plan and platform configuration
Design and advise on implementation plans — sequencing, dependencies, resourcing, and technical approach — rather than simply executing a pre-set template
Work with Product and Engineering to scope and discuss integrations with client technical teams (APIs, SFTP, data feeds), defining what's feasible and what the client needs to build or provide
Lead structured implementation programmes for enterprise clients, managing complex timelines, dependencies, and senior stakeholder expectations
Analyse client datasets, fund structures, and workflows to design and configure optimal platform solutions
Run executive business reviews with C-level contacts alongside Account Managers, distinct from technical discovery sessions, to align on progress and value delivered

sections.title: Requirements
bullets: 3–6 years leading enterprise B2B SaaS implementations end-to-end, ideally within financial services or asset management — you've personally configured the platform, run the data migration, and solved the technical problems, not just coordinated the project plan and chased other people's tasks
Strong working knowledge of private markets — you can hold your own in a conversation about waterfalls, capital calls, or LP reporting requirements without translation
Genuinely hands-on and technical: comfortable working with APIs, data mapping, and integration concepts, and confident scoping technical requirements directly with a client's IT or data team
Proven experience running discovery workshops that produce a concrete implementation plan — not just a requirements document
Highly analytical, with strong Excel skills and comfort reconciling and migrating complex client datasets
Exceptional project management instincts — you track every dependency, own every deadline, and communicate proactively when things shift

A natural relationship-builder who's comfortable being the day-to-day face of a vendor to a demanding, sophisticated client — you read a room, adapt your style to a CFO or a data analyst, and can challenge and guide senior stakeholders with confidence

Delivery substance first: this isn't a role where charm and responsiveness alone can carry you — clients trust you because you know their data and their platform inside out, and the relationship is built on that

ashby:base-power:2d211740-29ae-4306-a542.summary: Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: We are seeking a strategic operator to own one of Base's most important partnerships: installer and electrician capacity. This partnership covers the last step of getting a battery on a member's home, and it continues to scale into new territories across the country.

As the primary point of contact, you will represent Base in all interactions with our installer partners and be accountable for the success of the relationship. That means driving new installer capacity, unit economics, and quality outcomes, while making sure our partners stay motivated to win alongside us. Base Field Ops collaborates closely with Deployments, Launch, Growth, Software, and Hardware to deliver results that matter.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Own and maintain subcontractor relationships to grow Base's install capacity across the country
Build trusted relationships with executives and on-the-ground teams
Work with Launch to rapidly go to market in new territories
Negotiate contracts and terms
Manage the day-to-day relationship with installer partners
Set, track, and deliver against internal targets across Base teams to achieve partnership goals
Identify future opportunities to improve process, offerings, and outcomes through data, technology, and strong commercial instincts

sections.title: What You'll Bring
bullets: Proven experience standing up and leading large-scale partnerships or initiatives in a high-growth environment
Electrical engineering experience and acumen
Strong organizational and interpersonal skills to coordinate across multiple teams and stakeholders
Commercial acumen to structure, negotiate, and sustain win-win-win outcomes for Base, our partners, and our members in a B2B2C environment
Analytical and data-driven mindset; comfort working with modern tools (e.g., SQL, dashboards, CRMs) and rolling up your sleeves when needed

sections.title: About the Team
paras: A battery isn't installed until a licensed electrician shows up at a member's home and does the work — and that's the part of the business most software companies never have to solve. Our team builds and runs the network of subcontractor crews that makes that happen, market by market, from contract terms to crew capacity to on-site quality. When we open a new territory, this team is the reason a member's install date is real instead of a guess. The work is hands-on: negotiating rate schedules, setting capacity goals, auditing billing, and sitting across the table from installer executives to keep them building with us instead of for someone else. It's a rare seat for someone who wants to see a national infrastructure buildout scale one signed contractor at a time, not from a dashboard.

Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.

ashby:brightwheel:cff1354b-acb0-4556-86c.summary: Early education is one of the most important determinants of childhood outcomes, a critical support for working families, and a $175B market that remains underserved by modern technology. Brightwheel is the largest, fastest growing, and most loved platform in early ed, trusted by millions of educators and families every day. We are a three-time Cloud 100 company , backed by top investors including Addition, Bessemer, Emerson Collective, Lowercase Capital, Notable Capital, and Mark Cuban.

sections.title: Our Team
paras: Our team is passionate, talented, and customer-focused. We embody our Leadership Principles in our work and culture. We are a distributed team with remote employees across every US time zone, as well as select offices in the US and internationally.

sections.title: Who You Are
paras: You're an AI-native product leader and builder who thrives in high-ownership environments. You're energized by the full spectrum of the job — from iterating on live features to investing in greenfield 0→1 bets — and you have the judgment to know when to pursue each. You're comfortable in ambiguity, decisive under pressure, and relentless about customer and business impact.
You will succeed in this role if you are:
bullets: Focused on customer and business impact. You care about creating real value for educators and families, and about proving a business that's worth growing
A practitioner-builder. You don't lead from a distance. You use AI and modern tooling in your own work to build, prototype, and learn, and to show what great looks like

Motivated by ownership. You want a large surface area and the full portfolio that comes with it — from finding product-market fit and proving out a business model on a 0→1 bet, to removing pain points on existing, heavily used features

sections.title: What You’ll Do
paras: Brightwheel sits at the center of early education, trusted by tens of thousands of schools and millions of families. We have more high-value opportunities than we have product managers, and you'll own one of them end to end.

The most likely starting point is enrollment — how schools fill their open seats and keep the families they already have. A center licensed for 50 children running at 42 is leaving real money on the table every month, and today the work of chasing inquiries, running tours, and confirming re-enrollment happens across inboxes and spreadsheets. Some of what schools need already exists in brightwheel. Some of it doesn't. You'll build both, and build the business around it.
This is an individual contributor role with significant scope — one of the broadest product mandates at brightwheel, with direct partnership with our CEO and executive team from day one.
bullets: Own the vision, strategy, and execution for a high-impact product area — from growing what already works to defining and launching what doesn't exist yet
Make the case for where we invest next, with evidence — including what to stop

Shape pricing and go-to-market for new capabilities you launch — from packaging to validating willingness to pay
Drive AI into the product in ways that genuinely improve outcomes for providers, staff, and families — not as a checkbox
Define success metrics, track performance, and communicate progress and tradeoffs clearly to leadership
Partner tightly with engineering and design to ship with urgency, unblock the team, and keep them focused on what matters
Contribute to brightwheel's product culture — raise the bar for product quality, velocity, and customer impact

sections.title: What You've Done
paras: We are open to a variety of backgrounds, but qualified candidates usually bring:
bullets: A record of building products customers love. You have the product taste and judgment to know what to build and what to leave out, and the customer empathy to find real needs before the data exists
Something taken from 0→1. You've built something new and gotten it to real customer pull, and you can point to the signal that proved it
Proven ownership of complex, cross-functional product initiatives with measurable customer and business outcomes
Strong product judgment and prioritization. You know what to work on, what to cut, and can drive alignment while balancing speed, quality, and learning
Communication and presence. You can set a vision, align an executive team, and inspire the builders who join you
Applied AI in your own work. You use AI and modern tooling to build and ship faster, and to go deeper across disciplines
Experience building and shipping AI-powered product features (bonus)
SaaS background, especially in products with complex operational workflows (bonus)

ashby:checkout.com:e9960d73-c6d2-4f92-b6.summary:
We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.

We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and…

sections.title: The Role
paras: Checkout.com is looking for a Director, Strategic Account Management to lead the strategy, performance and growth of a portfolio of our most critical clients.

This is a leadership opportunity for an experienced commercial operator who can build trusted merchant relationships, develop a high-performing account management team and turn portfolio insight into sustainable growth. You will help Checkout.com become the partner of choice for strategic accounts through exceptional value, expertise and commitment, while setting the direction for account planning, execution and performance.

You will represent the voice of strategic clients across Checkout.com , influence senior internal stakeholders and bring together the right teams to solve complex challenges, unlock expansion opportunities and strengthen long-term partnerships.

sections.title: How You’ll Make an Impact
bullets: Portfolio strategy and growth: Own the strategy for a portfolio of strategic accounts. Anticipate long-term merchant needs and identify opportunities to increase processing volume, net revenue, retention, share of wallet, product adoption and client value.

People leadership: Lead, coach and develop a team of Strategic Account Managers. Set clear expectations, support career development and build a culture of accountability, collaboration and high performance.

Commercial and operational ownership: Set portfolio objectives, forecasts and performance indicators. Use data and commercial judgement to create scalable ways of working across account planning, forecasting, escalation management and performance reviews.

Senior client engagement: Build trusted, multi-level relationships with senior client stakeholders and functional leaders. Create strong senior-level engagement, establish Checkout.com as a long-term strategic partner and personally engage where relationships, risk or growth opportunities require additional leadership.

Strategic planning and governance: Set the standard for account plans, strategic business reviews and joint planning with merchants. Ensure priorities, complex challenges, risks and opportunities are aligned and actively managed across relevant regions and functions.

Cross-functional leadership: Mobilise Product, Operations, Legal, Risk, Finance, Data Science and other teams around portfolio priorities. Lead coordinated responses to complex merchant challenges, remove internal blockers and improve the end-to-end client experience.

Product, market and business influence: Bring structured client insight and market intelligence into Checkout.com . Influence product and service priorities by connecting client needs, payments trends, competitive dynamics and regulatory developments to actionable recommendations.

Leadership contribution: Help shape how Checkout.com manages and grows its most important client relationships, strengthens its position as a partner of choice and scales a consistent, high-value merchant experience.

sections.title: What We’re Looking For
bullets: Significant experience leading strategic or enterprise account management, customer success or commercial teams in a B2B environment, ideally within FinTech, payments, technology or another complex, high-growth industry.
A proven track record of growing strategic accounts through retention, expansion, product adoption and long-term relationship development.
Experience hiring, coaching and developing high-performing teams, with a clear and inclusive leadership style.
Strong commercial acumen, including the ability to set strategy, manage forecasts, interpret performance data and deliver against ambitious objectives.
Demonstrable experience building senior-level engagement with internal and external stakeholders and leading complex commercial discussions.
Proven ability to build and leverage relationships across strategic customers, partners and the wider payments ecosystem, creating opportunities for insight, collaboration and portfolio growth.
The ability to move between strategic direction and detailed execution, while maintaining focus across multiple accounts, priorities and workstreams.
Excellent judgement, problem-solving and influencing skills, with the confidence to lead through ambiguity and manage risk.

sections.title: Bring all of you to work
paras: We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.
Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.
We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

ashby:convex-dev:e393cbb1-86f0-4848-8c9d.summary: Convex is the difference between coding and engineering. As app development becomes commoditized and the nature of applications changes, coding agents need a backend platform that codifies good systems design principles and is accountable for simplicity, correctness, scale and performance so that teams are able to build the applications of tomorrow. This is a very difficult product challenge: Convex needs to be incredibly easy to use both for agents and humans, but has to impose the right constraints that ensure that applications actually work and scale over the lifetime of a company. We’re looking for a product lead to help us shape the agentic/developer experience for the next chapter of Convex.

sections.title: The Role:
paras: Our team is exceptional at solving hard technical problems. We're looking for our second product manager to make sure we solve the right ones. You'll own full product areas end to end, working alongside our founders and engineers who have built some of the largest platforms in the world.

We are looking for a technical product manager with the taste, discipline, and restraint to help us find simple, elegant solutions to complex user problems. In a world where code has become cheap, we believe that deep user discovery and product thinking is more important than ever. Some days you'll be on calls with customers to understand why their team is spinning up hundreds of deployments. Other days you'll dig through usage data, write a crisp spec for a new platform API, or help our Heads of GTM and Marketing explain a new capability to developers.

sections.title: What You'll Do:
bullets: Own multiple product areas of the Convex platform (e.g., component marketplace, standard library, agentic coding experience). Alongside the founders, you’ll set and drive the roadmap for your area.
Talk to customers every week. Turn what you learn into clear problem statements, specs and prioritization calls.
Define and instrument the metrics for your areas, and use data to decide what's working.
Work closely with engineers from design through launch.
Partner with the GTM team on launches and messaging for your areas and our support team to define the product roadmap.
Bring your own read on what developers and agents need. Push back when you think we're wrong.

sections.title: What Excites Us:
bullets: Minimum 2–4 years as a PM at a technical or developer-facing company, or 2–4 years as a software engineer who wants to move into product.
A CS degree, or equivalent hands-on engineering experience. You should be comfortable reading code, using a CLI, and having real technical tradeoff discussions.
You've shipped something you're proud of and can explain why it was the right thing to build.
You are comfortable doing user interviews, writing product specs, and performing data analysis.
Clear, simple writing.
Bonus: Hands-on experience with TypeScript and/or modern web development technologies.
Interest in working in person at our SF office.

sections.title: Ideal Characteristics
paras: This is an attempt to outline some characteristics of people who tend to thrive at Convex. We have a high demand for conceptual thought and architectural sensibilities, while also having the typical demands of a small startup.

ashby:deepjudge:87169663-4b19-4204-890b-.summary:

Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most.

ashby:delinea:f525b8cf-6894-4d5c-9aef-79.summary:
About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

sections.title: Technical Account Manager Position Summary
paras: 80% of breaches involve privileged credential misuse. Delinea, the leader in Cloud-Ready Privilege Access Management is ready to help minimize the potential attack surface. As such, we are seeking an experienced and self-driven Technical Account Manager to join our outstanding Customer Success team. If you are well versed in and have a passion for Privilege Access Management, Cyber Security, Infrastructure and Identity Security, and experience working with Enterprise customers in a technical trusted advisory role, you might have what it takes to become a Delinea Technical Account Manager. This individual will need to be detail oriented, proactive, and able to perform well under pressure. If you are motivated by challenges, have a passion for excellence, and are customer-centric then this could be the opportunity for you. Accountability, motivation, creativity, and tenacity are the key success attributes for this role.

sections.title: What You’ll Do:
bullets: Serve as a technical subject matter expert for Delinea’s Privilege Access services and product offerings

Be the customer trusted advisor to ensure engagement and success with the Delinea solution deployment, expedite resolutions to obstacles, and help them derive the most out of their Delinea investment.
Regularly monitor customer health, and communicate results with regional sales team, support, and renewals team
Deliver remote services to new and existing customers including software configuration, onboarding, and training
Engage with customers to quickly resolve high priority issues impacting their service delivery

Track new bugs, new product releases, and security vulnerabilities and proactively notify customer of any changes that may impact its environments. Will serve as the customer advocate for promoting customer interest within Delinea Engineering and Product Management organizations for future functionality and product roadmap items.
Regular review sessions to validate plans, configurations, and designs centered around Delinea software and operations.
Document customer environment details and share with Delinea Support and Engineering teams for faster issue root-cause and resolution.

Understanding of applications, infrastructure and processes used in large organizations that are typically integrated with Privilege Access Management solutions
Previous experience with Delinea or with other Privilege Access Service solutions such as CyberArk, BeyondTrust, etc. is a big plus
Experience leading large, transformational technology projects that cross typical enterprise silos
Experience addressing significant technical challenges with minimal supervision or guidance.

ashby:emerald-ai:f7e2b621-1e26-43b1-beda.summary:

sections.title: About Emerald AI

sections.title: About the Role
paras: We're hiring our first Sales Engineer to pair directly with our founding Account Executive in North America. You are the technical half of a two-person deal team: the AE owns the commercial motion, you own the technical win.

Our buyers are developers, ML engineers, and CTOs, and they don't buy on slides. They buy when someone credible sits with them, looks at their workload, and shows them that open models on Featherless are faster, cheaper, and more reliable than what they're running today. That's your job — hands on keyboard, in the customer's stack, from first technical call through production rollout.

Because you're the first SE here, you'll build the function as you go: the demo environment, the POC playbook, the benchmark harness, the security answers, the migration guides. Every deal you win should make the next one easier to win.

Run technical discovery: map each prospect's models, workloads, latency and throughput targets, spend, and constraints
Design and drive POCs and benchmarks that prove Featherless against the incumbent — closed-model APIs, another inference provider, or self-managed GPUs
Build the demo environment and reusable technical collateral that the whole GTM team sells with
Own technical objection handling end-to-end: performance, reliability, cost modeling, security, and data handling
Be the field's voice into product and engineering — you'll know what we're losing on before anyone else does

bullets: Lead technical calls tailored to each buyer's stack: architecture reviews, live demos, and working code against their real use case
Build migration paths off closed-model APIs and onto open weights — model selection, evaluation, prompt and output parity, cutover plan
Run benchmarks and produce the throughput, latency, and cost-per-token analysis that anchors the business case the AE builds
Scope and execute POCs with clear technical success criteria, then hold the customer and us to them
Write the technical sections of proposals, RFP responses, and security questionnaires; keep a reusable answer library so we never write the same answer twice
Support onboarding and first production workloads, then hand off cleanly and stay available for expansion

Make the hard calls—balancing customer impact, business opportunity, technical complexity, speed, and long-term product quality.

Raise the bar for product thinking across the team by creating clarity, accelerating learning, and establishing principles and success measures that endure.

Strong product judgment and the ability to make sound tradeoffs among user experience, business impact, technical complexity, quality, and speed.

ashby:opengov:5648a8f3-a6f6-41fa-8334-51.summary: OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at O penGov.com .

sections.title: Job Summary
paras: OpenGov is seeking an AI Solutions Engineer to serve as a dedicated practitioner within the Applied AI team, focused on Sales/GTM use cases across the revenue organization — SDR outbound, AE pipeline and opportunity management, and CSM account management and renewals — along with the account/opportunity intelligence that feeds all three. This role sits at the intersection of seller workflows, revenue systems, and applied AI, and includes hands-on GTM engineering: building the workflows, integrations, and automations across revenue systems that make sellers faster. It exists to systematically redesign how OpenGov's revenue organization runs its motion in an AI-native world, from lead through cash and the renewals that follow.

This is a technical role applied in a traditionally non-technical space. You bring a sharp problem-solving mind, comfort with modern AI tools, and the instinct to decompose a complex, manual seller workflow into its components — and then design something fundamentally better. You need the ability to think from first principles, build trust with sellers and RevOps before designing for them, and own the full lifecycle from problem discovery to solution adoption.

You will build the agents and systems that turn raw go-to-market signal (procurement data, contract/vendor intelligence, account and contact records, call and email activity) into action sellers actually take — signal-to-sequence automation for SDR outbound, next-best-action and deal-risk surfacing for AE opportunity management, and account-health and renewal-risk surfacing for CSMs. You will also serve as product owner for systems built entirely in house, and be the primary AI capability advisor for the revenue organization.

sections.title: You Will…
bullets: Serve as product owner for systems built entirely in house : drive the roadmap, prioritization, and quality bar for the call- and deal-intelligence and other revenue systems the Applied AI team builds, in partnership with sales leadership and the RevOps/analytics counterpart.

Design the human oversight for every agent you ship : approval gates, escalation paths, and clear ownership boundaries so SDRs, AEs, and CSMs stay in control of what goes out under their name — an agent recommends and drafts, a human approves and sends.

Build and run evaluation frameworks for agent behavior : seed scenarios, scoring rubrics, and regression checks that prove an agent is producing good contacts, good sequencing, good deal guidance, and good call and deal intelligence output before and after it goes into production — not just that it runs.

Instrument and monitor production agent activity : track model and tool calls, tie agent actions back to pipeline and revenue outcomes, and give sales leadership and RevOps a clear read on what the agents are actually doing and whether it's working.

Partner with AI platform, systems, and/or data engineers when required : clearly define requirements, translate business needs into actionable technical specs, and own outcomes on the business side — build first, then delegate backend complexity (data modeling, integrations, infrastructure) to platform engineering.

Serve as the primary AI capability advisor for Sales : help sales and RevOps leaders understand what is possible with AI today, evaluate build vs. buy tradeoffs, identify where AI should not be applied due to compliance or brand-risk constraints, and set realistic expectations on scope and timeline.

Drive adoption and change management for tools you build : shipping is not the finish line. You own ensuring that agents and workflows are understood, trusted, and refined based on real feedback from the SDRs, AEs, and CSMs who depend on them.

Maintain a living roadmap of AI initiatives across Sales : track ideas, in-flight projects, and delivered solutions; report on impact (e.g., pipeline contribution, conversion lift, call- and deal-intelligence adoption); and continuously reprioritize based on business need and resource availability.

sections.title: Required Experience
bullets: Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, or a related field.

Production experience building and operating agents, including tool use, context engineering, and evaluation frameworks — you can point to something you shipped and describe how you knew it was working.
Past experience/exposure to GTM and Sales at a SaaS company.

Exceptional problem-solving and first-principles thinking: you can look at a messy, manual seller process, pull it apart into its components, and design a fundamentally better solution — not just automate what exists today. You approach unfamiliar domains as an asset, not a liability.

Strong user research and discovery skills: you build trust with sellers and RevOps before designing for them, surface the root problem underneath the surface problem, and validate solutions with the people who will actually use them.

Ability to bridge technical and business stakeholders: you can explain a complex AI workflow to a sales stakeholder, articulate data access tradeoffs to a compliance stakeholder, and translate business requirements into engineering specs — all in the same week or even day.

Comfort working in a code-first approach to traditionally no-code enterprise sales systems (Salesforce, Outreach, Gong, or similar). Familiarity with how enterprise revenue data flows across systems is a plus.

Strong analytical skills: comfortable with data in spreadsheets, dashboards, or basic BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or similar), and working fluency with SQL; able to extract insight from data and frame it clearly for both technical and non-technical audiences.

sections.title: Nice to Have
bullets: Prior experience in sales/revenue operations, customer success operations, or a forward-deployed/solutions-architecture role.
Experience with Claude Code, the Claude Agent SDK, or building MCP servers.
Familiarity with AI governance concepts: prompt design, data access controls, audit trails, and responsible AI principles in sensitive-data environments.
Experience building or deploying workflow automations or internal tools without engineering support.
Familiarity with Snowflake, Looker, or similar data platforms at a data analysis level (not data engineering).
Applied ML and experimentation background: A/B testing, propensity models, recommendations, or lead/account scoring.
Experience working in a fast-moving, high-growth SaaS environment where the org is actively evolving and priorities shift quickly.
Experience working at the intersection of Sales and Marketing, or Sales and RevOps — roles that required navigating cross-functional data ownership and system permissions.

ashby:procurify:bab0f6a4-be5c-4870-a991-.summary:

We’re building an ambitious, high-performance company where talented people are trusted with meaningful ownership and given the opportunity to make a real impact. We’re seeking a talented and collaborative Senior Product Manager to join us in building innovative, customer-centric solutions that drive meaningful outcomes.

sections.title: ABOUT THE ROLE
paras: As a Senior Product Manager at Procurify, you will play a key role in defining and delivering high-impact solutions within one of our core product areas. You will work in a fast-paced, AI-Native product and engineering environment. sections.title: Focus on outcomes, not just features

ashby:ramp:d64609dd-c391-45a2-bfdb-c1bb3.summary:
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

sections.title: About Ramp
paras: The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: Ramp builds software that moves real money, from bill payments and corporate cards to reimbursements, accounting integrations, and travel. Our customers rely on us to keep their operations running: invoices get paid, books get closed, and finance leaders can trust the data behind every decision.

In this role, you will be the person who spots where customers are getting stuck and drives issues to a clear resolution. You will learn a complex product deeply enough to troubleshoot across payments, bank linking, accounting syncs, and card programs, then partner with teams across Engineering, Risk, Product, and Partnerships to get problems solved. This is not script-based support. You will triage, investigate, and make high-signal judgment calls throughout the day.
You will thrive in this role if you are a systems thinker and deeply customer obsessed. Support is the baseline. How you think about improving processes, tools, and outcomes is what sets you apart.

sections.title: What You’ll Do
bullets: Be the voice of Ramp's Customer Support. You'll spend your day engaging with customers, primarily via live calls, email, and chat.
Diagnose across a broad product surface. Ramp isn't one product — it's payments, cards, travel, accounting integrations, and more. You'll need to understand how they connect and where they break.

Build and shape AI tools, not just use them. Ramp is building AI into CX operations. You'll use AI-powered research tools and proprietary tools like Glass daily, provide direct feedback on what's working, and play an active role in how these tools evolve. You're not just a user — you're a builder. We are all builders at Ramp.

Communicate with precision and empathy. Our customers are financially sophisticated. You need to explain what's happening, what you're doing about it, and what they should expect — clearly and without filler.

sections.title: What You Need
bullets: You're a systems thinker: you don't just solve the ticket in front of you, you ask why the problem exists and how to prevent it from happening again.
You actively use AI tools — Claude, Notion AI, research and workflow tools — and can demonstrate how you've applied them to get real work done. This is a hard requirement.
You're fast-moving while holding yourself to a high bar for execution: you balance speed, accuracy, and thoroughness in every interaction.
You can hold a technical conversation about how systems connect (APIs, bank integrations, accounting software) even if you're not writing code.
You manage competing priorities without dropping things. When you have 15 open issues across 4 internal teams, nothing falls through.
You write clearly and concisely. You can explain a payment reconciliation issue to a CFO without jargon.
You're comfortable on the phone. Many interactions start there.
You have a demonstrated track record of exceeding key performance standards, including CSAT, QA, and speed-of-service metrics.

ashby:raspberry:47aeb1c8-70df-4511-b467-.summary:
Raspberry AI is building the agentic platform transforming how fashion and retail is created and brought to market. Raspberry brings AI into the center of the process, connecting design, product development, merchandising, marketing, ecommerce, and wholesale teams in one platform.

Our customers use Raspberry to move from an idea to production-ready designs, assortments, campaigns, ecommerce imagery, and sales materials in a fraction of the time. Today, some of the world's leading fashion brands and retailers, including SKIMS, Fabletics, Under Armour, Oscar de la Renta, Walmart, rag & bone, Kate Spade, Savage x Fenty and more, are using Raspberry to rethink how their teams work.

sections.title: Why Raspberry AI
paras: We've raised $29M from a16z, Khosla Ventures, Greycroft, and leaders across the fashion industry.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: AI Implementation Specialists turn a signed contract into a team that actually works in Raspberry. You'll onboard new enterprise customers, train their designers, product developers, and merchandisers, and help them rebuild real workflows around generative AI, not just learn which buttons to click.

You'll sit on our Customer Enablement team, working alongside Sales, Customer Success, and Product. You'll own a book of implementations from sales handoff through steady-state adoption, run live training on site and remote, and turn what you learn in the field into resources that let customers teach themselves.
Success is measured by time-to-value for new customers, active usage after onboarding, customer satisfaction with training, and the quality of the insight you bring back to Product.

sections.title: Responsibilities
bullets: Lead customer implementations end to end, from sales handoff and kickoff through onboarding, training, and handoff to Customer Success.
Run live training, on site and remote, tailored to each team: designers, DPC and product developers, merchandisers, and marketing and ecommerce teams.
Map each customer's current workflow (sketch, CAD, 3D, PLM, sampling, line review) and show them where Raspberry fits and what it replaces.
Build workflow-specific prompting techniques, templates, and best practices that help customers get production-quality output.
Track adoption after onboarding, spot accounts that stall, and step in with targeted sessions before usage drops.
Create scalable, AI-first resources (help docs, Loom walkthroughs, workflow guides, office hours) so customers can learn without a live session.
Partner with Sales during late-stage deals and pilots so customers are set up for success from day one.
Feed structured customer insight to Product and Engineering: blockers, workflow gaps, model quality issues, and recurring feature requests.

sections.title: Who You Are
bullets: 3+ years in fashion, apparel, footwear, or retail, in design, technical design, product development, DPC, or creative technology.
Deep familiarity with fashion workflows and tools: Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop, CLO 3D or Browzwear, and PLM systems.
Experience training, onboarding, or enabling others, whether customers, internal teams, or students.
Hands-on with generative AI tools (Midjourney, ChatGPT, Adobe Firefly, Stable Diffusion, etc.) and able to show your own work.
A strong teacher who can make new technology click for a skeptical senior designer and a VP of Product in the same room.
Comfortable owning several customer implementations at once, with organized follow-through and clear documentation.
Willing to travel to customer sites for kickoffs and on-site training.

ashby:redis:66d02763-c44b-4c20-a5cf-9565.summary: We're Redis. We built the product that runs the fast apps our world runs on. sections.title: About Redis
paras: Redis is the world’s fastest data platform. With cloud and on-prem databases for caching, GenAI, and more, Redis helps digital businesses set a new standard for app speed.

sections.title: The Team
paras: We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to join our Redis Cloud team in Vancouver, Canada.

In this role, you will help shape the future of Redis Cloud for three of our most important customer segments: enterprise customers modernizing mission-critical applications, digital-native companies building and scaling fast-moving products, and teams developing AI-powered applications. This is a strong fit for someone who enjoys working closely with customers, translating complex problems into clear product direction, and partnering across engineering, go-to-market, and customer-facing teams to deliver meaningful business impact.

sections.title: The Role
bullets: Own product strategy and execution for Redis Cloud capabilities that serve enterprise customers, digital-native companies, and AI-native applications.
Define detailed product requirements in close partnership with engineering and key stakeholders, and manage the lifecycle of one or more product areas end to end.
Work directly with customers and internal stakeholders to understand pain points, validate priorities, and turn feedback into roadmap decisions.
Partner closely with sales, solutions, marketing, enablement, and customer success to support successful launches, adoption, and business alignment.
Collaborate across distributed teams and global stakeholders to prioritize work, communicate trade-offs, and drive high-quality execution.
Act as a product evangelist internally and externally, helping teams tell a clear story about customer value, product direction, and use cases.
Bring strong technical judgment to conversations spanning cloud infrastructure, modern application architectures, data platforms, and AI workloads.

sections.title: What You’ll Bring to Redis
bullets: Experience in product management for cloud platforms, data infrastructure, databases, developer platforms, or AI-related products.

Strong technical depth in storage, networking, and modern software development processes, including Agile development practices and the effective use of AI tools to accelerate discovery, specification, iteration, and execution.

Adaptability to the changing role of product management in an AI-enabled SDLC, including faster feedback loops, AI-assisted engineering workflows, and evolving cross-functional ways of working, with the ability to understand architecture trade-offs and translate them into product requirements.

Solid understanding of cloud platform ecosystems across AWS, GCP, and Azure, including core infrastructure services, marketplace and procurement models, APIs, identity and access patterns, observability, and partner integrations.

Familiarity with the lifecycle of cloud products and services, including provisioning, upgrades, maintenance windows, reliability, operational readiness, supportability, and end-of-life considerations.

Strong product sense for enterprise and digital-native customers, with the ability to turn ambiguous customer, field, and market input into crisp requirements, prioritization decisions, and measurable outcomes.
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

sections.title: About Rescale
paras: We are looking to add a Customer Success Engineer, Public Sector to our team in the US! As a Customer Success Engineer, you are the trusted technical advisor of named Rescale customers. sections.title: You Will Work On and Impact:

Lead technical activities from deployment, to lunch and learn, to user training and support.
Collaborate with Rescale Solutions Architect to plan and execute a successful deployment of Rescale solutions.
Work independently to analyze technical needs, requirements, the customer's current infrastructure, operations, and workflows.
Onboard new customer workflows and grow Rescale footprint.
Gain deep knowledge of customer workflows and HPC environments.

Articulate and present Rescale solutions at conferences, user groups, webinars, etc.

sections.title: Key Qualifications
bullets: Experience working on complex technical challenges within the defense or public sector.
Customer obsession is your top priority.
You use empathy to approach customer solutions.

You have at least 2 years of software, hardware, or cloud experience in a customer facing role
B.S. in engineering, computer science, math, physics or equivalent.

bullets: 3 years of enterprise cloud, hardware, or software technical experience.

Strong presenter and are able to present highly technical topics in an easy-to-understand manner.
M.S. in engineering, computer science, or equivalent preferred.
Ability to manage multiple projects which are complex in nature and coordinate colleagues across diverse teams and locations.
Demonstrate understanding of HPC, scheduler, IaaS, scripting languages and how these tools are used and deployed by customers.

ashby:revenuecat:cdf67b07-fc4d-47d9-a68b.summary:
RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile.

We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $18B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We're a remote-first team of 180+ people across 30+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance.

This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that…

sections.title: The role:
paras: A developer is getting ready to launch their first subscription app. A growth team wants to improve its paywalls. A founder has heard about Daily Payouts and wants to understand whether it could help. They all reach out to RevenueCat, and they all deserve a useful conversation. You’re that conversation.

As a Product Expert, your job is to understand what someone is trying to accomplish, explain and demo the relevant parts of RevenueCat, and help them take a sensible next step. Sometimes that means helping them get started themselves. Sometimes it means bringing in an Account Executive, a Sales Engineer, Support, or someone else.

This is a new role at the intersection of inbound sales, product education, and helping developers get started. You’ll own the inbound conversations that don’t go directly to our Account Executives or Sales Engineers, and help us build a great experience for the people behind them.

sections.title: What you’ll be responsible for:
bullets: Make a great first impression. Respond to inbound interest, run useful discovery conversations, and understand the app, the people building it, their goals, and what they need from us.

Turn product knowledge into practical guidance. Give clear demos, answer questions, and connect the relevant parts of RevenueCat to someone’s situation. Help them understand the product, its limits, and what getting started involves.
Help straightforward adoption move forward. Guide people through the next steps they can take themselves, share useful resources, and follow up so a good conversation turns into progress.

Make handoffs easy for the customer. Keep clear notes on goals, requirements, open questions, and next steps. Stay responsible for follow-through until the next owner has picked up the conversation, so the customer doesn’t have to start over.

Help us improve the experience. Share recurring questions and feedback with the team. Turn what you learn into better demos, resources, and playbooks, and help us see where conversations or handoffs get stuck.

sections.title: What you’ll need to be successful:
paras: We’re more interested in your product knowledge, judgment, and helpfulness than a particular degree, job title, or number of years on your résumé.
bullets: Strong, hands-on knowledge of RevenueCat. You can show how you’ve used the product and explain it in your own words. We care about what you understand and can demonstrate, whether you learned it at work or through your own projects.
Curiosity about the app business. You want to understand how developers build products, make money, and grow, and how RevenueCat can help.
Clear, friendly communication. You listen carefully, ask useful questions, write concise follow-ups, and explain the same idea differently to a developer, founder, or growth lead.

Technical common sense. You’re comfortable discussing SDKs, APIs, subscriptions, and paywalls at a practical level. You can recognize when a question needs an engineer and bring them in with useful context.
Commercial common sense. You can spot a promising opportunity, understand why timing and fit matter, and recommend a useful next step without making every conversation a pitch.
Ownership and follow-through. You can manage several conversations, keep your notes and commitments straight, and make sure people hear back from you.
The ability to work remotely and keep learning. You communicate proactively, ask for help when you need it, and can work hours that meaningfully overlap with customers and teammates in your region.

sections.title: Ideally, you:
bullets: Have built or shipped an app using RevenueCat, including a side project or Shipaton entry.
Have helped people through support, community participation, teaching, demos, or another customer-facing role.
Have experience with developer tools, subscriptions, or a product with both self-service and sales-assisted customers.
Enjoy improving a process or creating a resource that makes the next person’s job easier.

ashby:sevenai:e06133a6-cc41-4755-a9e1-4b.summary:
7AI is the foundational AI security company. Founded in 2024 by Cybereason co-founders Lior Div and Yonatan Striem-Amit, we came out of stealth in February 2025 to take on the non-human work of the SOC. Our platform pairs a federated SIEM with AI agents that detect, investigate, respond, and hunt, plus dedicated threat hunting and threat intelligence, with humans on the loop.

Backed by $166 million in total funding from investors including Index Ventures and Blackstone, we're building the AI foundation for security operations in the agentic era, and we're still early. That's the appeal: you'll join at a pivotal stage where your work shapes what 7AI becomes, alongside security veterans who've built this before. Our culture runs on respect, collaboration, and a shared bar for excellence, all pointed at one goal, delivering real outcomes for the customers who trust us to defend them.

sections.title: Overview
paras: Our sales team is growing faster than its onboarding. As a Sales Enablement Manager, you'll own that program and the strategy behind it. You'll decide how every new Account Executive and Sales Engineer ramps, turn what our sales leaders, SEs, and product team know into curriculum and certifications, and report to leadership on whether it's working. This is a build role. You'll ship a first version fast, read the results in Gong and Salesforce, and improve it in the field.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Design and run onboarding for new AEs and SEs as one coordinated program, with clear ramp milestones for each role.
Partner with sales leadership, SE leadership, and product to turn their expertise into curriculum, role-based learning paths, and certifications.
Define the ramp metrics, instrument them in Salesforce, and report results to leadership. Show what changed in rep behavior and pipeline, not only who completed training.
Use Gong and Salesforce to find coaching gaps and skill patterns. Decide what to build next and work with front-line managers to act on it.
Own the enablement content library, including how content is created, reviewed, and retired as the product and market move.
Lead launch readiness and ongoing enablement programming for the existing team.
Build repeatable AI-assisted workflows that let a small enablement function cover more ground.

sections.title: Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams
paras: Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.
To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:
bullets: No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

Please always verify communications:


• Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com .

Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

greenhouse:anthropic:5427479008.summary: Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. sections.title: About the role
paras: As a Customer Success Manager on Anthropic's Public Sector team, you will be the post-sales trusted advisor helping national security customers realize the value of Claude and turn their investment into mission impact. You'll combine your customer success expertise with technical fluency to drive adoption of Claude Code, the Claude API, and Claude for Government (C4G) on classified infrastructure delivered through a cleared cloud provider, while maintaining our high standards for safety, security, and discretion.

Working closely with our Sales, Applied AI, Product, Engineering, and Policy teams, you'll guide customers from deployment through enablement, model migration, renewal, and expansion. You'll develop genuine partnerships with customers' AI leadership, platform and compute teams, security and accreditation officials, and mission operators—and with the cleared cloud providers and system integrators that deliver alongside us. Your understanding of their mission, how they accredit and govern capabilities on classified fabrics, and how they evidence value to oversight will help them deliver decision advantage.

Drawing on both your national security expertise and technical knowledge, you'll serve as a strategic advisor throughout their journey with us—helping them navigate constraints that don't exist in commercial or federal civilian deployments: classified-fabric accreditation, fixed compute capacity, compartmentation, limited telemetry, and need-to-know discipline. Much of this work happens onsite, in the customer's spaces, on their systems.

sections.title: Key responsibilities:
bullets: Partner with the account executive and Applied AI architect to deeply understand the customer's mission requirements and translate them into an account and success plan, ensuring alignment between mission objectives, the customer's investment, and technical implementation

Support customers building with Claude Code, the Claude API, and Claude for Government on classified infrastructure—managed configuration, capacity and throughput planning, and workload onboarding—with a working understanding of accreditation requirements (FedRAMP High, IL5/IL6, classified-fabric accreditation)

Own Executive Business Reviews that function as discovery and alignment—leaving executives with sponsor commitments, mutual next steps, and a mission-outcome narrative that supports the renewal decision—and serve as the primary conduit between the customer, cleared cloud providers, and Anthropic
Work onsite frequently at customer facilities for enablement, workshops, and relationship building, on the customer’s systems and within their security and need-to-know rules
Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities, agentic and Claude Code implementation patterns, and national security AI policy
