sections.title: About Canopy
paras: Canopy is one of the fastest-growing companies focused on workforce safety in healthcare. Backed by leading venture investors, Canopy is transforming how hospitals protect and support frontline staff through its Connected Safety Platform, combining wearable safety technology, real-time location intelligence, intelligent alerting, and managed services built specifically for healthcare environments.

We operate in high-trust, high-reliability environments where software quality, operational resilience, and customer experience matter deeply. Today, more than 70 leading health systems and 1,000 healthcare facilities rely on Canopy to protect frontline staff, improve emergency response, strengthen employee confidence, and support workforce retention.

We are scaling rapidly, expanding our product portfolio, and partnering with some of the most recognized health systems in the country. This is an opportunity to join a high-growth, venture-backed company at a pivotal stage, where you can make a meaningful impact on both the business and the safety of healthcare workers nationwide.

sections.title: The Role
paras: We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the platform capabilities that power every Canopy product. This includes shared platform services, APIs, the real-time location platform, enterprise integrations, reporting and analytics capabilities, and the foundational infrastructure that enables scalable product delivery and customer deployments.

This is a high-impact, deeply cross-functional role for a PM who thrives at the intersection of technical depth and product strategy. You'll work closely with engineering, product, data, and customer-facing teams to define platform strategy, prioritize investments, and deliver capabilities that power Canopy’s products.

sections.title: What You’ll Own
paras: You'll define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the platform capabilities that power Canopy's products, including:
bullets: Shared platform services, including the real-time location platform that powers every Canopy product
APIs and platform interfaces that enable consistent product development
Enterprise integrations (with EHRs, security platforms, identity providers, and other customer systems)
Reporting and analytics capabilities that demonstrate customer impact
Platform reliability, scalability, and partner experience

sections.title: Success in this role looks like
bullets: Product teams build faster by leveraging shared platform capabilities
Enterprise integrations are easier to implement and maintain
Platform services consistently meet reliability, scalability, and performance targets
Customers can clearly measure the value Canopy delivers through reporting and analytics
Platform investments accelerate product delivery across the portfolio

greenhouse:cardata:4402823009.summary:
Cardata is where driven people make an outsized impact. We’re a small but mighty team transforming how businesses manage vehicle reimbursement — replacing outdated programs with smart, automated solutions.

Our vision is bold: to provide the most comprehensive, intelligent, and automated software and services for creating ideal vehicle programs. And we’re building toward that vision every single day.

Join us and you’ll find challenge, growth, and the chance to deliver real impact — helping hundreds of companies and thousands of drivers across North America focus on the work that matters most to them.

sections.title: Customer Success Manager
paras: At Cardata, customers are at the centre of everything we do. Our Customer Success team protects retention by helping customers get greater value from their reimbursement programs and building strong, lasting relationships.

As a Customer Success Manager , you'll own a portfolio of customer relationships after implementation, helping customers navigate their programs, resolve challenges, and achieve meaningful business outcomes while contributing to Cardata's GRR and NRR goals.

This is a hands-on role that combines customer relationship management with problem-solving and day-to-day execution and management of customer expectations. You'll develop a strong understanding of our platform and reimbursement workflows to confidently investigate issues, troubleshoot challenges, and guide customers toward practical solutions.

sections.title: What you'll do
bullets: Own a portfolio of customer relationships, understanding their business objectives, reimbursement programs, and ongoing needs to deliver a responsive, reliable customer experience while managing customer expectations.

Investigate and resolve customer challenges, using platform knowledge, documentation, data, and internal resources to troubleshoot issues, identify root causes, and drive solutions through to completion.

Manage a high volume of customer requests, triaging inquiries, prioritizing by urgency and business impact, and maintaining clear ownership of deadlines and follow-ups and managing customer expectations.
Communicate clearly and proactively, setting expectations, explaining complex information, and keeping customers informed throughout the resolution process.
Develop deep knowledge of Cardata's platform and reimbursement workflows to confidently answer questions, guide customers, and identify opportunities to improve program effectiveness.
Monitor customer health, adoption, and program performance, identifying risks and taking action to protect retention and customer satisfaction.
Lead customer check-ins, and renewal preparation, using customer insights to demonstrate value and provide practical recommendations.
Identify opportunities to improve customer outcomes and expand value, partnering with Account Managers on potential growth opportunities.

sections.title: What you'll bring
bullets: 3–5 years of experience in Customer Success, Client Services, Implementation, or a similar customer-facing role, within B2B SaaS.
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the curiosity and resourcefulness to investigate unfamiliar issues, identify root causes, and independently drive resolution.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to simplify complex information, manage stakeholder expectations, and navigate challenging customer conversations.
Excellent organization, prioritization, and time management skills, with experience managing a busy portfolio, high volumes of inquiries, and competing deadlines.
Strong customer ownership and relationship-building skills, with a track record of building trust, following through on commitments, and delivering a reliable customer experience.
Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to quickly learn SaaS platforms, understand operational workflows, and navigate interconnected systems.
Sound judgment and attention to detail, particularly when assessing urgency, investigating issues, and determining when to involve internal partners.
Strong ability to recognize customer risks, protect retention, and identify opportunities for account growth.

sections.title: Why you’ll love working at Cardata:
paras: We’ll be honest — Cardata isn’t for everyone. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, take extreme ownership, and constantly push yourself (and your work) to be the best, you’ll fit right in.

You’ll be surrounded by driven teammates who genuinely care — about the work, about our customers, and about helping each other succeed. Together, we take on ambitious goals and celebrate the wins along the way.
What we offer in return for you bringing your best:
bullets: Remote work and flexible working hours
Mentorship and development opportunities (to help you achieve your career goals!)
Extended medical & dental benefits
Healthcare spending account
$3,000 annual Health and Wellness Spending Account to support your overall wellbeing
Employee assistance program (EAP)
Flexible (Unlimited) Time Off: No annual cap on vacation, supported by a trust-based, flexible approach to time away.

greenhouse:cloudflare:8158104.summary: At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

sections.title: About the Department
paras: Cloudflare’s Enterprise Applications Team is responsible for running and maintaining the essential systems that enable internal teams to operate efficiently. Within the Enterprise Applications Team is a technical group responsible for the HR tech suite and associated integrations with various platforms.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: We are looking for a Workday Integration Specialist to join our People & Payroll Systems team, an energetic team focused on building resilient and efficient solutions to difficult problems. The Workday Integration Specialist serves as a technical point of contact for production support issues and assigned projects, including solution design, technical documentation, and implementation. We strive to build reliable, fault-tolerant systems that can operate at Cloudflare’s scale.

sections.title: What You’ll Do
bullets: Work on a range of system integration support, technical debt and HR initiatives involving Workday, Greenhouse, middleware, data lakes and other systems.
Help design, build, test, and support inbound and outbound Workday integrations.
Integrate Workday HCM with third-party global payroll and benefits providers.
Configure integration security.
Troubleshoot and fix production support issues.
Develop Workday custom reports, including BIRT.
Create and launch EIBs.
Work with teams to communicate, verify, and test desired functionality changes.

sections.title: Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge and Experience
bullets: Bachelor’s degree or higher in a technology-related field, or relevant experience implementing business systems.
Proficient technical knowledge of Workday HCM, Benefits, Compensation, Talent Management, and third-party payroll vendors such as ADP, CloudPay, Safeguard, and TMF.
Workday integration certifications preferred.
2–3 years of experience in software development.
Experience developing Workday inbound and outbound integrations.
Experience developing Workday custom reports, dashboards, and calculated fields.
Experience developing Workday EIBs, Core Connectors, RaaS, and web services.
Experience working with Workday Studio.

greenhouse:cloudflare:8365223.summary: At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: Cloudflare's developer platform lets developers build full-stack applications that run on a global network. Alongside Workers, developers rely on a growing set of data products: D1 for serverless SQLite, Durable Objects for stateful coordination, KV for global key-value storage, R2 for object storage, and Hyperdrive for connecting to existing databases.

This role will be leading a new database product from its earliest days. You will define what the product is, who it is for, and why developers should choose it over the databases they already know. Then you will get it to first customers and see it through to general availability.
Your mission in this role is to lead the project of building a database designed for agent-driven development workflows, getting both the core tradeoffs and the fine-grained details right.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Run customer discovery to find and sharpen the problem the product should solve.
Define the product, its target users, and its positioning against established databases.
Work with engineering on core design tradeoffs across consistency, latency, scale, durability, and cost to serve.
Recruit design partners and run a private beta that produces honest, usable feedback.
Set success metrics and use them to decide what to build, change, or cut.
Own pricing and packaging, grounded in customer value and unit economics.
Drive the product from first prototype through beta, launch, and GA.
Make sure it fits naturally with Workers, Wrangler, and Cloudflare's existing data products.

sections.title: Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience
bullets: Proven experience as an EM, PM or founder. You've led teams to ship before and can point to impact.
Experience taking a product from 0 to 1. You are comfortable with ambiguity and can turn an open problem into a clear plan.
Real experience building on databases. You have modeled data, written queries, and run SQL or NoSQL databases in production.
Solid grasp of distributed-systems tradeoffs. You can reason through replication, consistency models, and failure modes with engineers.
Comfort with pricing and unit economics for infrastructure. You know what a workload costs to serve and how that shapes a price.
Deep empathy for developers and how they choose and adopt new platforms. You understand what it's like to bet your application on a database someone else built.
Hands-on ability to write code and use AI and the Internet to learn new things fast.
Exceptional communication and collaboration skills. You can translate between engineering domains and align diverse teams on goals.

sections.title: Equity
paras: This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

greenhouse:coinbase:8269052.summary:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase .

The Infrastructure Marketing team is building awareness and demand for Coinbase's stablecoin payments, trading, agentic finance, and custody products. As Senior Product Marketing Manager, you'll lead integrated marketing initiatives that span content, demand generation, events, and sales…

sections.title: What you'll do:
bullets: Lead cross-functional marketing initiatives across content, demand generation, events, communications, and sales enablement to build awareness and generate qualified leads for Coinbase's infrastructure products.
Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for PSPs, money movers, cross-border companies, and banks, focused on reaching, engaging, and activating them through targeted messaging and campaigns.
Drive marketing for agentic finance across Coinbase for Agents and agentic payments, including thought leadership content, social campaigns, and product announcements.
Partner with tier-one partners on co-marketing programs, from partnership launch planning through ongoing activation and performance measurement.

sections.title: Required Skills and Experience:
paras: Pay Transparency Notice: Base salary varies by location (see range below). Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility, and benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k)).
bullets: 7+ years of experience in payments, stablecoins, or fintech marketing, with a track record of building go-to-market strategies that drove measurable pipeline or revenue growth.
3+ years of product marketing experience in a startup or high-growth environment, including ownership of positioning, messaging, and launch execution.
Proven ability to write clear, compelling blog posts, partner briefs, and sales collateral that are accurate, tailored to each audience, and polished, with a sharp eye for editing your own work.
Experience developing and managing co-marketing programs with external partners, including joint campaign planning and cross-functional coordination.
Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

greenhouse:connerstrongbuckelew:44644540.summary: Job Summary: The HIF Account Manager supports the Executive Director in the administration of eight Health Insurance Funds and one County Insurance Commission Health program. This role manages key operational, financial, and strategic activities, including underwriting, budgeting, rate development, vendor and committee coordination, regulatory support, and broker service. The Account Manager also serves as a central resource to internal teams, Fund leadership, and external partners, helping ensure the Funds operate effectively, compliantly, and with long-term stability.

sections.title: Fund Administration and Leadership Support
bullets: Assist the Executive Director in the daily administration of eight Health Insurance Funds and one County Insurance Commission Health program.
Support ongoing Fund operations and provide administrative and strategic assistance on special projects and priority initiatives.
Serve as a professional resource to internal teams, brokers, vendors, commissioners, and regulators in support of effective Fund operations and long-term stability.
Perform additional duties as delegated by the Public Sector Practice Leader, Executive Director, and Fund Commissioners/Executive Committee.

sections.title: Executive Committee Meeting Support
bullets: Attend all Executive Committee meetings.
Partner with the Executive Director to present reports and respond to Committee questions and requests.
Identify meeting takeaways, document action items, and coordinate with appropriate team members to complete follow-up activities.
Support Committee needs before, during, and after meetings.

sections.title: New Member Underwriting
bullets: Coordinate the underwriting process for prospective new members by facilitating communication among producers, the data team, underwriting, and the Executive Director.
Review and update submissions with the underwriter and Executive Director.
Verify rate accuracy and confirm that premium levels align with underwriting determinations.
Provide missing rate records and other required underwriting information.
Assist the Executive Director with new Fund feasibility studies and related implementation processes.

sections.title: Budget Development and Financial Planning
bullets: Work with the Executive Director, Systems Analyst, data team, actuary, and underwriting team throughout the annual budget process.
Gather, review, validate, and finalize budget-related reports.
Coordinate with the actuary to obtain projections and assist in determining appropriate claim budgets.
Evaluate RFP responses related to expense lines.
Partner with the Executive Director to present budgets and funding options to the Finance Committee and Executive Committee.
Assist members in understanding budget assumptions, assessments, and related financial impacts .

greenhouse:conviva:7989527003.summary: Conviva is the experience analytics platform for AI agents, apps, and streaming. Conviva pioneered quality of experience measurement for streaming video and has supported live digital experiences across 20 Super Bowls, 10 Olympic Games, and five FIFA World Cup tournaments. With full-census, real-time, stateful analytics, Conviva shows what consumers actually experience, not just whether systems are running, and connects that experience to revenue, retention, and risk.

sections.title: ABOUT THE ROLE
paras: Conviva is looking for a Product Marketing Manager to own positioning, messaging, and go-to-market execution for a core part of our product portfolio. You'll partner closely with Product, Sales, and Customer Success to translate technical capabilities into compelling market narratives, and you'll be working as part of a small, high-impact marketing team. This role is a strong fit for someone who has run at least one full product launch cycle, is comfortable digging into technical product detail, and wants ownership over how a product is positioned and sold.

sections.title: WHAT YOU'LL DO
paras: ■ Translate product and engineering output, such as release notes, specs and demos, into sales-ready messaging, packaging and documentation.
■ Own the space between product and the field. Spot what Sales needs before anyone asks, and build it.
■ Own positioning and messaging for new features and releases, and keep it consistent across web, sales collateral and campaigns.

sections.title: WHAT YOU BRING
paras: ■ 5+ years of experience in product marketing, preferably in B2B SaaS or a technical product environment.
■ Real technical depth in analytics, data, or AI and agent-based products. You can sit through an engineering demo and explain to a sales rep why it matters to a customer.
■ Proven track record of leading product launches from planning through execution.

sections.title: WHY CONVIVA
paras: Your point of view will shape how our products go to market. You’ll work directly with executive leadership, and your impact will be visible across the company.

The expected salary range for this full-time position is $150,000 - $200,000 + equity + benefits. Compensation is determined by numerous factors such as your qualifications, experience, relevant education or training, and work location.
Learn more at conviva.ai and follow the company on LinkedIn and YouTube .

greenhouse:counterparthealth:8076921.summary:
At Counterpart Health , we are transforming healthcare and improving patient outcomes with our innovative primary care tool, Counterpart Assistant. By empowering Primary Care Physicians (PCPs), we help deliver better patient care at a lower cost through early diagnosis and longitudinal management of chronic conditions.

We are seeking a Provider Success Manager to est ablish relationships with healthcare providers and drive the adoption, expansion, and success of Counterpart Assistant (CA). This individual will be responsible for managing a portfolio of provider partnerships, ensuring that practices successfully implement and maximize their use of our platform to thrive in value-based care.

sections.title: As a Provider Success Manager, you will:
bullets: Own & Manage Provider Relationships : Serve as the primary point of contact for provider primary care partners. Build trusted, consultative relationships to drive adoption of CA.

Support Provider Recruitment Activities as Product SME : Partner with CA GTM team to execute a provider onboarding and training best practices, with a focus on devising strong in-office workflows and working closely with practices (including clinical + non-clinical staff) to drive effective adoption of the platform.

Optimize Provider Success & Retention : Implement and oversee a structured engagement plan to ensure providers maximize their use of our platform, achieve measurable success in value-based care, and remain long-term partners.

Lead Data-Driven Decision-Making : Analyze provider performance metrics and proactively identify and review trends, opportunities, and risks with partner practices. Drive interventions to improve provider outcomes and increase platform utilization.
Influence and drive adoption of best practices : Implement CA best practice in various types of PCP practices.
Cross-Functional Player : Collaborate with internal teams, including sales, product, and operations, to refine Counterpart Health’s offerings based on provider feedback and market trends.

sections.title: Success in this role looks like:
bullets: You are a champion and ambassador for Counterpart Assistant with your portfolio of primary care partners. Primary Care clinicians are reaching out to you to learn more about how CA can support them in achieving better outcomes in value-based care.
Due to your dedicated support, guidance, and trusted partnership, clinicians and staff are now proficient users of CA.
Engaging with CA has seamlessly become part of their daily workflow, and all key engagement metrics are being successfully metric.

sections.title: You should get in touch if:
paras: About Counterpart Health: In 2018, Clover Health set out to do something unprecedented: build a clinically intuitive, AI-enabled solution that fits within physicians' workflows to help support the earlier diagnosis and management of chronic conditions.

Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value-based care.
With an exceptional team of value-based care and technology experts, Counterpart Health is driving value-based care at the speed of software.
bullets: You have 5-7+ years of experience in provider engagement, healthcare account management, or value-based care consulting, with a strong track record of success and provider adoption and retention.

Proven ability to build collaborative relationships with clinicians and staff to drive operational change, and to translate operational data into actionable performance metrics and scorecards that help primary care physicians achieve improved clinical and financial outcomes.
Deep understanding of primary care and/or ambulatory care workflows and proven success Implementing, improving or changing clinical process workflow
You have knowledge of EHRs - ideally in a Primary Care setting, medical billing, reimbursement models, Medicare Advantage, and risk-based payment arrangements.
You have strong project management skills, with the ability to prioritize competing initiatives and drive measurable outcomes.
You are willing to travel up to 75% of the time to foster relationships and support provider practices.
Understanding of value based care models, population health or quality improvement.
Implementing value based care tools and technology products in primary care.

greenhouse:cribl:6225333004.summary:
Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

sections.title: Why You’ll Love This Role
paras: Cribl is hiring an Onboarding Program Owner to architect, scale, and elevate how we ramp new revenue talent. In this high-visibility, high-impact role, you will own the end-to-end onboarding strategy and execution across Regional Sales Managers, Regional Directors, Solution Engineers (SEs), SE Leaders, and Customer Success Engineers (CSEs).

You'll blend instructional design, interactive facilitation, and continuous innovation—running multi-day bootcamps, leveraging AI-driven roleplay, and partnering with leadership to accelerate rep time-to-productivity and drive a target 10% lift in organizational revenue contribution.

sections.title: As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…
paras: By Day 90, you will have launched a refreshed onboarding path for a priority role and piloted a new baseline assessment model.
bullets: Role-Based Onboarding Paths: Architect and maintain tailored onboarding journeys for sales, technical, and post-sales roles. Sequence foundational business context, methodology (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message), and specialized technical tracks built in partnership with Technical Enablement.

In-Person Bootcamps & Cohort Operations: Plan, facilitate, and deliver ~5 interactive bootcamps per year, coordinating executive SMEs, designing practical group exercises, and driving dynamic pre- and post-boarding communication.

Practice & Proof of Skill: Build modern practice environments—including AI-driven roleplay scenarios (Hyperbound), call intelligence analysis (Gong), hands-on discovery simulations, and rigorous certification milestones testing real-world execution over recall.

Baseline Assessments & Personalized Coaching: Design post-onboarding skill baselines and individual gap readouts for new hires and frontline managers to drive targeted, just-in-time enablement and continuous skill development.
Mentorship & Manager Partnerships: Partner with RDs and tenured RSMs to scale a structured peer-mentorship network and equip frontline leaders with 1:1 coaching tools for post-onboarding handoffs.

Data-Driven Optimization: Collaborate with Revenue Operations to connect onboarding milestones directly to business performance metrics—tracking ramp velocity, time-to-first-meeting, time to Stage 2/3 pipeline, and ARR contribution.
We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones - you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours.
Days 1–30 (Diagnose): Audit current onboarding content and feedback across roles. Interview frontline managers and new hires. Partner with RevOps to align on contribution and ramp metrics.

sections.title: If You’ve Got It - We Want It
paras:
The salary for this role is dependent on geographic location and will be based on the individual candidate's job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

In addition to base salary, for sales and some sales-adjacent roles, employees are eligible to earn incentive compensation (commission). For all other roles, employees are eligible to participate in the Cribl Corporate Bonus Program.

In addition to a competitive salary, Cribl also offers a generous benefits package which includes health, dental, vision, short-term disability, and life insurance, paid holidays and paid time off, a fertility treatment benefit, 401(k), and equity.
Interested in joining the Cribl herd? Learn more about the smartest, funniest, most passionate goats you’ll ever meet at cribl.io/about-us .
bullets: 5+ years in sales enablement, revenue training, or frontline sales management in B2B SaaS, with 3+ years owning onboarding for quota-carrying or technical sellers.
Hands-on instructional designer and engaging facilitator: proven track record of creating dynamic curricula, practice scenarios, and certifications yourself.
Fluency in enterprise sales methodologies (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message) and ability to operationalize them within practical training modules.
Data-driven mindset with experience partnering with Revenue Operations to connect enablement milestones to ARR growth and sales velocity.
Tech stack proficiency with platforms like Gong, Hyperbound, Seismic, Rox, Salesforce, and modern enablement/LMS tools.
Strong executive presence and empathy: comfortable coaching sellers, influencing frontline managers, and presenting to leadership.

BONUS POINTS:


• Prior experience as an enterprise seller/SE, experience in data/observability/security SaaS, or experience building AI-assisted coaching frameworks.

greenhouse:dominodatalab:8121838.summary: At Domino, we build solutions that help the largest, highly regulated organizations adopt AI to accelerate mission-critical use cases. Our platform integrates a streamlined model and app development environment, advanced model, agent, and app hosting capabilities, and novel governance capabilities providing regulator-ready AI at scale. Our customers — like Johnson & Johnson, GSK, Bristol Myers, UBS, FINRA and the US Navy — are using our software to solve some of the most important challenges in the world, such as developing new medicines, securing our financial markets, or protecting our country. Backed by Sequoia Capital, Coatue Management, NVIDIA, Snowflake and other leading investors, we have been in business for over a decade but are still a small team operating with the spirit of a startup. In the world of AI today, we believe that the future is still being invented — and we want…

sections.title: What we are building
paras: Domino's Solutions team is the customer-facing engine behind how leading enterprises build, scale, and govern AI-powered applications - solving real business challenges, not just deploying technology. Solutions Engineering earns technical credibility before the deal closes. Customer Engineering, where this role lives, owns everything after: adoption, implementation, expansion, and the kind of delivery that makes customers renew and grow. Global Support and SRE keeps it all running at the level enterprise customers depend on. Three functions, one relentless motion, and a team that earns its reputation on what it ships, not what it scopes.

sections.title: What your impact will be
bullets: Own pre-sales as a function, not a set of individual deals: set and enforce the standards for how opportunities get qualified, how POCs get scoped, and how SEs engage — with a single, consistent bar across the team regardless of which GVP or AE is in the room.

Be the check on the sales process: you have the standing and the judgment to push back on a deal, a scope, or a timeline when it doesn't meet the bar — even when that's an uncomfortable conversation with a GVP or a top seller.

Coach and develop the SE team: you sit close enough to the opportunities to give real, specific feedback — on technical approach, on deal strategy, on what a customer actually needs — not just process oversight from a distance.

Bring enough technical fluency to ask the hard question before the customer or the SE gets there: you don't need to build the model, but you need to know when the architecture, the POC design, or the technical claim doesn't hold up.

Partner as a peer with GVPs and account teams: you have the presence and the sales acumen (not just the technical credibility) to shape how a $5M+ enterprise deal is qualified, resourced, and run — and to hold your ground when priorities compete.

Build the operating rhythm for pre-sales: capacity allocation, opportunity prioritization, and the recurring cadence that keeps SE time going to the deals that deserve it — and away from the ones that don't.
Recruit and build the bench: as the team scales, you're identifying gaps, hiring against them, and building a pre-sales org that can hold its own against enterprise competitors.
Be a discerning voice on deal quality: you can tell the difference between a deal worth the team's time and one that isn't, and you say so — with a recommendation, not just a red flag.

sections.title: What we look for in this role
bullets: 8+ years in enterprise, solution-selling pre-sales or sales engineering, with direct experience on complex $5M+ deals — you know what real enterprise sales cycles demand.
People leadership experience is required: you've built, coached, and managed a technical or pre-sales team, and you know how to develop talent, not just direct it.
An operational builder at heart: you define process where none exists, hold people to it, and don't let "how we've always done it" survive contact with a better way.

Presence that holds up in the room: you can stand toe-to-toe with a GVP or an enterprise seller and not get steamrolled — this role sets the bar on rigor, and needs someone who can enforce it under pressure.

Technically conversant, not technically deep: you understand what's possible and plausible in AI/ML delivery well enough to be respected by the SE team and to catch a shaky technical claim — you're not expected to be the most technical person in the room.
Sharp, discerning judgment on opportunity quality: qualification, technical fit, and deal health are things you evaluate critically, not rubber-stamp.
No vertical expertise required — your edge is operational and sales rigor, not domain specialization.
Comfortable with travel and heavy customer-facing time; East Coast location preferred.

sections.title: What we value
paras: Visa Sponsorship: Visa sponsorship (including H-1B and other employment-based visa categories) may be available for this position depending on business considerations and the role's requirements. Sponsorship eligibility is assessed on an individual basis and is not guaranteed for any role or candidate. All applicants are encouraged to apply regardless of current or future immigration status.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role's On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. sections.title: About the role
paras: Customer Lifecycle Marketing (CLM) is responsible for engaging and nurturing customers through their entire lifecycle and across the Justworks platform. Your mission is to build and scale the Customer Lifecycle Marketing function with a goal of systematizing how we engage customers at critical points in their lifecycle to grow our business. You will be responsible for creating the strategy that guides our customer lifecycle priorities, along with developing the operating model that enables us to execute against the strategy. You will manage our portfolio of lifecycle marketing programs and campaigns across customer stages, segments, and objectives.

You will also lead our Customer Lifecycle Marketing team, developing and growing t talent, a team of lifecycle marketing experts, building the capabilities, expertise the function needs to operate at scale. sections.title: Job Summary
paras: The Regional Account Manager (RAM) – Rare Disease is a critical commercial role responsible for expanding the diagnosed patient population and driving appropriate treatment initiation through education-driven, data-informed field engagement. This role is designed to complement existing Regional Business Manager (RBM) coverage by placing primary emphasis on new and earlier patient identification, diagnostic pathway enablement, and referral network activation.

The RAM serves as a field integrator across the local ecosystem and works in close collaboration with Regional Business Managers and relevant cross-functional partners.

Phaidra is building the future of industrial automation.

The world today is filled with static, monolithic infrastructure. Factories, power plants, buildings, etc. operate the same they've operated for decades — because the controls programming is hard-coded. Thousands of lines of rules and heuristics that define how the machines interact with each other. The result of all this hard-coding is that facilities are frozen in time, unable to adapt to their environment while their performance slowly degrades.

Phaidra creates AI-powered control systems for the industrial sector, enabling industrial facilities to automatically learn and improve over time. Specifically:

sections.title: About Phaidra
paras: Our team has a track record of applying AI to some of the toughest problems. From achieving superhuman performance with DeepMind's AlphaGo , to reducing the energy required to cool Google's Data Centers by 40%, we deeply understand AI and how to apply it in production for massive impact.

Phaidra’s ability to achieve its mission is determined by our ability to work together — as defined by our core values: Agency, Velocity , Craft , and Truth . We seek individuals who embody these values, as they are instrumental in ensuring our team consistently delivers excellence and fosters an engaging and supportive culture

Phaidra is based in the USA, but we are 100% remote with no physical office. We hire employees internationally with the help of our partner, OysterHR . Our team is currently located throughout the USA, Canada, UK, Sweden, Spain, Portugal, the Netherlands, Singapore, Australia, and India.
bullets: We use reinforcement learning algorithms to provide this intelligence, converting raw sensor data into high-value actions and decisions.
We focus on industrial applications, which tend to be well-sensorized with measurable KPIs — perfect for reinforcement learning.
We enable domain experts (our users) to configure the AI control systems (i.e. agents) without writing code. They define what they want their AI agents to do, and we do it for them.

bullets: You will act as an internal and customer-facing SME on a range of initiatives, including the delivery of platinum support to customers, providing technical advice to research projects, and supporting sales and marketing efforts.

Private markets are the new public markets. The most important companies of this era are private, and almost no one can own them. What's missing is the financial system public markets spent a century building: exchanges, custodians, brokers, and ways for ordinary people to buy in. Private markets, now $28T, never had the equivalent. AngelList is building it.

The last decade of structural innovation in venture happened here: syndicates, SPVs at scale, Rolling Funds, scout programs. Today we have $200B+ in assets and 30,000+ startups funded on our platform. The rest of private markets is next. Funds is the software and services behind private funds, Nova is the banking network, Meridian is the wealth platform for accredited investors, and USVC is the brand behind a registered fund that lets anyone invest in venture.

sections.title: About AngelList
paras: Working here means an unusual amount of agency on a problem that matters. Titles are closer to suggestions, and there are about 200 of us building what private markets never had. Come build it with us.

About the Role:
When a GP raises a fund on AngelList, LPs trust the platform as much as they trust the GP. LP Relations is the team behind that trust: the front line for more than 100,000 investors, especially in the moments that are hardest to get right. It comes down to the details, like clear communication, accurate reporting, document management, correct money movement, and capable support when questions come up.
This is a customer-facing role. You'll own day-to-day communications with the investors in the funds we administer, represent AngelList, and work across legal, tax, banking, sales, and product to resolve issues and deliver best-in-class service. You'll handle high volume with accuracy and care, notice when something is urgent, sensitive, or outside your scope, and escalate with clear context so the right people can jump in. Every one of those conversations teaches you something about how capital moves through a fund and how our platform handles it.
We expect you to grind and we expect you to think. The strongest people on this team notice the patterns behind recurring issues and fix the system. You will surface what's broken, form a point of view on how it should work, and help turn that into better workflows, automations, and projects that make the experience better for every LP. The path from specialist to associate is built by people who use that foundation to develop real judgment about our investors, our product, and how to solve problems that don't come with a playbook.

lever:quandri:423ac9bc-333d-48d9-86fc-a2.summary:
Who we are
Our mission at Quandri is to transform insurance into a trusted and delightful experience using AI. We are building the AI operating system for North America’s best insurance agencies and brokerages.

For the first time ever, we have the technology to fundamentally change how insurance operates, and the stakes are human. Better insurance means families protected from harm, businesses able to take risks, and communities more resilient when the worst happens. For insurance practitioners, the ability to deliver this level of service finally becomes possible.

sections.title: What we do
paras: Quandri brings deeply specific, vertically-focused AI to the industry’s most critical stakeholders:insurance agencies and brokerages.

Agents are the lifeblood of the industry, the place where most property and casualty insurance is sold and serviced. Yet operating an agency is harder than ever. Peak product complexity, accelerating consolidation, a deepening talent crisis, and the AI revolution are all reshaping how agencies work.

Quandri sits at the cutting edge of this shift, rebuilding how agencies operate one workflow at a time. We pair a deep understanding of insurance processes, systems, and data with serious technical capability and proprietary models, so the transformation is tangible and operational rather than aspirational.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: You will build Quandri's next product, taking our proven platform into commercial lines. This is the rare version of zero-to-one work. Our platform already processes thousands of personal lines renewals in production, so you're building something new on a foundation of working technology, real revenue, and customers ready to serve as design partners.

Commercial is a harder problem than personal lines. The policies are more complex, carrier appetite is harder to read, and nobody has automated the workflow well, which is exactly why it's worth doing. You will own the product end to end, running discovery with agencies, defining what we build first, deciding what we reuse from the platform and what we create new, and driving it through launch to early adoption. You will report to the VP of Product, building on discovery already underway.

Success means market entry and early customer adoption, not features shipped. If ambiguity energizes you and being in front of customers every week sounds like the best part of the job, you will thrive here.

sections.title: Why this Role Matters
paras: Commercial is the next big market for Quandri. We've built a proven platform and a deep understanding of insurance agencies and brokerages, and expanding into commercial lines is how that foundation compounds. The market is large and underserved, with commercial renewals still running through manual, fragmented processes that eat broker time out of all proportion to the premium earned. You'll define Quandri's entry and write the playbook we use for every market after this one.

sections.title: What You'll Do:
bullets: 0-to-1 Product Development: Commercial has genuinely hard problems, and you'll own them from problem definition through launch and iteration. Expect to validate solution approaches with cheap prototypes before committing engineering, and to design experiments that test the riskiest assumptions early.

Go-to-Market & Early Adoption: Getting to market is part of the job, not a handoff. You'll partner with Sales and Marketing on commercial positioning, target customers, and early-adopter criteria, then choose the right design partners from our existing customers and fold what they teach us back into the product and the messaging.

Measurement & Iteration: You'll define the metrics that connect product usage to broker outcomes. At this stage, learning velocity matters as much as absolute numbers, so you'll build measurement to match and change course quickly when the outcomes aren't there.
